2520.a: Hakuryū-en Garden, 106 Kuramaninosecho, Sakyo Ward, Kyoto, 601-1113, Japan
2520.aj: 〒601-1113 京都府京都市左京区鞍馬二ノ瀬町１０６ 白龍園
2520.ed: Tranquil mountainside garden with a scarlet bridge & a Shinto shrine, known for its seasonal colors.
2520.edj: 穏やかな山あいの庭園。朱塗りの橋と神社があり、四季折々の彩りで知られている。

rv.t: Such a beautiful garden where we had a lovely wedding ceremony. The owner renting this out for different events with very limited number of persons. This hidden gem is a great place for photography and the name :" The Garden of the White Dragon".
We found the scenic Hakuryuen Garden randomly through a Google search. It has a certain hidden beauty. The lush moss, bridge, greenery and heart shaped window are breathtaking. 5 stars from us :)

I love the concept of limiting the number of visitors per day. It felt peaceful. Another thing I liked is how this garden is intertwined with nature. While every rock is thoughtfully placed and every moss is thoroughly maintained, it never felt overly manicured. Note that it's not open year round so check their website. You also MUST book ahead, online, in Japanese (I got someone to help me with that once in Japan).

2521.a: Waterway Pavilion, Nanzenji Furoyamacho, Sakyo Ward, Kyoto, 606-0000, Japan
2521.aj: 〒606-0000 京都府京都市左京区南禅寺風呂山町水路閣
catj: ヘリテージビルディング
2521.ed: People say this aqueduct features impressive red brick arches that blend beautifully with the surrounding temple scenery, and highlight that water still actively flows through it. Visitors also mention it's a popular and picturesque photo spot, especially during autumn and fresh green seasons. They also like that it's free to visit and offers a peaceful atmosphere, particularly in the early…
2521.edj: この水路閣を訪れた人は、周囲の寺院の風景に美しく溶け込む、印象的な赤レンガのアーチを高く評価しています。また、現在も水が勢いよく流れていることが特徴です。特に秋や新緑の季節には、人気の写真撮影スポットとして絵になるというクチコミが多くあります。無料で訪れることができ、特に早朝は静かで落ち着いた雰囲気を楽しめる点も好評のようです。

rv.t: The Suirokaku Aqueduct has the similar architecture as Pont du Gard but this one is still operational. It carries water from Lake Biwa into Kyoto. Walking along is also a fun experience.
A highly photogenic spot! Sometimes you'll catch couples (including foreigners) taking beautiful pre-wedding photos here.

Tucked within the serene grounds of Nanzen-ji Temple in Kyoto, the Suirokaku Aqueduct is a striking and unexpected architectural marvel. Built in the late 19th century during the Meiji era, this red brick aqueduct was designed to transport water from Lake Biwa to Kyoto—a bold symbol of modernization in a city steeped in tradition. Its Roman-style arches, weathered by time and moss, stand in beautiful contrast to the…

2522.a: Kyoto Botanical Gardens, Shimogamo Hangicho, Sakyo Ward, Kyoto, 606-0823, Japan
2522.aj: 〒606-0823 京都府京都市左京区下鴨半木町京都府立植物園
2522.ed: Expansive botanical garden showcasing a large array of exotic plants in a tranquil setting.
2522.edj: 静かな環境で外来種を含む多様な植物を展示する広大な植物園。

rv.t: Outstanding! This is my 4th time in Kyoto, but my first time visiting this beautiful botanical garden. So much much to see here and it's all being expertly looked after by the staff ❤️👍👍 I spent 2+ hours just strolling through this place and I'm sure I didn't see everything. There's even hidden art works! 😊👍👍 Well worth the 500JPY entrance fee. You can easily get lost in this place, so I highly recommend picking up…

I really enjoyed my visit to Kyoto Botanical Gardens. Making it to the conservatory right on time was a nice little moment, and it added to the charm of the day. The whole place felt easy to wander through, and I left feeling glad I stopped by.

Had an amazingly incredible time visiting the Kyoto Botanical Gardens! I was there in early October, but the temperature was a comfy 70-80 degrees, and there was still an abundant amount of plants and flowers in bloom outside of the greenhouses. I wish I could have gone back at night and experienced the Light Cycle event they had going on in their greenhouses, but we didn't have time! It was still a magical…

2523.a: Suika Tenmangu Shrine, 722-10 Ogicho, Kamigyo Ward, Kyoto, 602-0071, Japan
2523.aj: 〒602-0071 京都府京都市上京区堀川通上御霊上ル扇町７２２−１０ 水火天満宮

rv.t: Suika Tenmangu Shrine, located in Kamigyo Ward, Kyoto City, is a historic shrine that was built in 923 and calls itself "Japan's first Tenmangu Shrine." The main attraction is the two weeping cherry trees that bloom so beautifully that they cover the entire grounds. They tend to bloom earlier than Somei Yoshino cherry trees, and are usually at their best from late March to early April.
The entire shrine is covered by a huge cherryblossom tree, as if it has ceiling made of flowers. Willing to visit again :)
You need to ring the bell, and the staff will come out. The scenery on the roadside is very beautiful~

2524.a: Jodoji Ishibashicho, Sakyo Ward, Kyoto, 606-8406, Japan
2524.aj: 〒606-8406 京都府京都市左京区浄土寺石橋町

2525.a: Philosopher's Path (Tetsugaku no Michi), North End, Shishigatani Teranomaecho, Sakyo Ward, Kyoto, 606-8426, Japan
2525.aj: 〒606-8426 京都府京都市左京区鹿ケ谷寺ノ前町哲学の道
catj: ハイキング コース
2525.ed: Visitors say this walking path is beautiful, especially during cherry blossom and autumn foliage seasons, offering stunning views of the canal and surrounding nature. They also highlight the peaceful and tranquil atmosphere, making it a great place for a relaxing stroll. Many mention the numerous charming shops, cafes, and temples along the way, providing enjoyable stops.
2525.edj: この散策路は、特に桜と紅葉の季節に運河や周囲の自然の素晴らしい景色が楽しめ、美しいと評判です。また、静かで穏やかな雰囲気が、リラックスした散歩に最適だという声が多くあります。道中には魅力的なお店やカフェ、お寺が点在しており、立ち寄るのも楽しいというクチコミも多く見られます。

rv.t: The Philosopher's Path is a pedestrian walkway in the northeastern part of Kyoto, built alongside the Lake Biwa Canal. Stretching for about two kilometers, it connects Ginkaku-ji Temple with Nanzen-ji Temple. The path is lined with cherry trees, making it especially beautiful during the cherry blossom season. However, it is also charming at other times of the year, offering a peaceful and contemplative atmosphere…

29 March: I was fortunate to be here when the cherry blossoms were in full bloom!!! 🥰🥰💕 It’s a slightly short canal, but lined with huge trees, which makes for such a pretty sight really. Spent an hour and a half here taking pics, staring at the blossoms, and just taking everything in. 😹 Am blessed to be able to experience this! ❤️

Absolutely outstanding during cherry blossom season! This scenic canal-side walk is pure magic, lined with beautiful sakura trees that create a dreamy pink tunnel overhead. The entire path takes about 30-45 minutes at a relaxed pace, and you’ll be stopping for photos the whole way. It starts quite crowded near the beginning (especially around Ginkaku-ji), but gets noticeably quieter and more peaceful as you continue…

2526.a: Japan, 〒530-0051 Osaka, Kita Ward, Taiyujicho, 1−17 梅田アスカビル
2526.aj: 〒530-0051 大阪府大阪市北区太融寺町１−１７ 梅田アスカビル
catj: ビジネス センター

rv.t: 大阪市北区の太融寺近くでスーパーのライフの向かいにあります。

2527.a: Umeda Station, 3 Chome-1 Umeda, Kita Ward, Osaka, 530-0031, Japan
2527.aj: 〒530-0031 大阪府大阪市北区梅田３丁目１ 梅田駅
2527.ed: People say this train station is very convenient for quick transfers to various train lines and offers extensive underground shopping and dining options. They also highlight the lively and bustling atmosphere, especially during peak hours. Visitors appreciate the ability to access surrounding department stores and restaurants without exposure to rain.
2527.edj: この駅を利用した人は、様々な路線への乗り換えがしやすく、地下街には多くの店があるため、買い物や食事にとても便利だと評価しています。特に、雨に濡れることなく周辺の百貨店や飲食店に行ける点が好評のようです。また、活気があり賑やかな雰囲気で、特にピーク時には多くの人が行き交う様子がうかがえます。

rv.t: One can either love or hate it. This most probably one of Japanese most busy train stations. For me that’s a bit too much 😮‍💨
Huge shopping area，agree it's modern and convenient place . . that's why it's always crowded - filled with people everywhere，for. me it's too hustle and bustle 😅
Very busy train interchange stop in Japan. There are many eateries and convenience store around as well.

2529.a: Oji Coffee Roaster, トーショー第一ビル 1階 1 Chome-5-4 Oji, Kita City, Tokyo 114-0002, Japan
2529.aj: 〒114-0002 東京都北区王子１丁目５−４ トーショー第一ビル 1階 王子珈琲焙煎所サクラピアス
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
2529.ed: People say this cafe offers delicious coffee, including a fruity Shibusawa Eiichi blend and milk brew, along with tasty cherry castella. They also highlight the option to enjoy coffee in a relaxed, quiet atmosphere on the second floor, which doubles as a cigar bar in the evenings. Guests mention the convenient location near the station and the availability of PayPay for payments.
2529.edj: このカフェを利用した人は、フルーティーな渋沢栄一ブレンドやミルクブリューなど、こだわりの美味しいコーヒーが高く評価されています。また、美味しい桜カステラも評判のようです。2階は夜にシガーバーとして営業していることもあり、昼間も静かで落ち着いた雰囲気でコーヒーを楽しめるという声が多くあります。駅からのアクセスも良く、PayPayでの支払いも可能という情報があります。

rv.t: Went here on a weekend. We were seated on the first floor which was a non smoking area. It has 3 tables inside & 4 counterseats with an outlet. They also have a 2nd floor for smoking area. I ordered an Iced Cafe Latte & a Castella on Stick (Tiramisu flavored) for sharing. I enjoyed the Iced Latte. The Castella on Stick was good too. Glad it was not too sweet. Would love to try the Gelato next time.
Visitors feb 6th 2026 Lady told me there is no more French toast on menu for around a year 🙂‍↕️

Cute little coffee shop with about a dozen beans to purchase. Cold brew had one option which seems like a seasonal blend. Not bad. They also sell individual hand drip packets for those that need coffee to go.

2529.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

2530.a: Rikugien Gardens, 6 Chome-16-3 Honkomagome, Bunkyo City, Tokyo 113-0021, Japan
2530.aj: 〒113-0021 東京都文京区本駒込６丁目１６−３ 六義園
2530.ed: Picturesque garden featuring traditional Japanese landscaping, several teahouses & a central pond.
2530.edj: 伝統的な美しい日本庭園。茶室が複数あり、中央には池が配されている。

rv.t: Can't go wrong for 300 yen entrance fee. There aren't many sitting areas around the lake, so you're usually in a less scenic area if you want some shaded rest. We spent about an hour here. Very nice reprieve from the city. Would be tough to spend a lot more time than that unless you want to grab some sweets at the tea house (which did have nice lake view seating). Grounds very impressively maintained and I imagine…

Very meticulously designed. One needs to understand the designer’s intent before being able to appreciate. Try to mimic great Japanese natural beauty in miniature. It works, and the gardening is top tier. Worth the time and money even though we missed the booming of the big Sakura 🌸 tree. May not be a bad thing as the queue could be long if in season.

3/19/26 visit. Beginning of cherry blossom season. Came for the biannual evening event. So beautiful! Lovely garden, even without the blossoms. The walk is so peaceful, and we loved getting a break to stare at the pond from the tea house.

2531.a: Thai Spice Restaurant, Floor 5, 1 Chome-42-4, Toshima City, Tokyo 170-0003, Japan
2531.aj: 〒170-0003 東京都豊島区１丁目４２−４ Floor 5 タイスパイスレストラン

rv.t: I recently dined at Thai Spice, and it was an incredible experience from start to finish. The moment you walk in, you’re greeted with a warm and welcoming atmosphere that perfectly sets the stage for an authentic Thai culinary experience. The menu offers a great variety of traditional Thai dishes,Thai salads and every item we tried was fantastic. The Pad Thai was the best I’ve had, perfectly balanced with a hint of…

Tried the spicy pad thai. The portion was big, but it only came with three shrimp. It was definitely spicy, and the taste was good overall. The place is a bit small and it seems like there’s only one cook, so it might take some time for your order to be served.

Enjoyed the food there—everything was tasty, especially the pork rib, and the customer service was great. Only downside was the ventilation; the restaurant had a strong oil smell that could use some improvement.

2532.a: Kyu-Furukawa Gardens, 1 Chome-27-39 Nishigahara, Kita City, Tokyo 114-0024, Japan
2532.aj: 〒114-0024 東京都北区西ケ原１丁目２７−３９ 旧古河庭園
2532.ed: Western-style manor house on a hilltop, featuring manicured grounds with roses & Japanese gardens.
2532.edj: 丘の上に立つ西洋風のマナーハウス。よく手入れされたバラ園と日本庭園が見もの。

rv.t: A beautiful rose garden in the Tokyo area 🌹✨ Besides the colorful roses, there is also a lovely pond where visitors can relax and enjoy the scenery. The garden is quite popular, but it doesn’t feel overly crowded, making it a pleasant place to spend time. However, it is not very stroller-friendly since some areas cannot be accessed with a stroller, although there is a stroller parking area available near the…

Very surprising gardens, in the sense that they are not as well known as others, and are also very cheap to visit. However, aside from the rose collection, the real treat is the classic Japanese garden with the traditional small bridges, lanterns, etc. Great to hide away on a hot day, photo location or just relax and read a book.

We visited randomly but it turned out to be the rose festival so it was very crowded !! But the roses were beautiful but too many people are taking photo shoots with the roses and blocking the paths. I visited many years ago and had a nicer experience. Weekday would be better ! The actual garden is nice and we tried rose milk ice cream which was tasty and refreshing

2533.a: Japan, 〒160-0004 Tokyo, Shinjuku City, Yotsuya, 1 Chome−１２−11 comodo cafe 迎賓館赤坂離宮
2533.aj: 〒160-0004 東京都新宿区四谷１丁目１２−１１ comodo cafe 迎賓館赤坂離宮
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
2533.ed: People say this cafe offers delicious light meals, including sandwiches and seasonal tartines, along with a variety of desserts and refreshing drinks. They also highlight the spacious, clean, and comfortable atmosphere, noting it's a great spot to relax. Other reviews mention the service can be slow.
2533.edj: このカフェを利用した人からは、サンドイッチや季節のタルティーヌなどの軽食が美味しいという声が多くあります。また、様々なデザートや飲み物も提供されており、これらも好評のようです。店内は広々としていて清潔感があり、快適な雰囲気でリラックスできる場所だと評価されています。 一方で、注文した料理の提供が遅いというクチコミもあります。

rv.a: もう一度食べたい旨グルメ
rv.t: 【赤坂迎賓館】夏の観光の救世主！絶品ひんやりスイーツが楽しめる快適カフェ🍧✨ 夏の赤坂迎賓館周辺は日陰が全然なくて本当に灼熱…！🥵 「暑すぎて限界！ちょっと休憩したい…」という時に絶対に行ってほしいのが『Comodo cafe 迎賓館』です。 🥭 マンゴーパルフェ パレススタイル（1,200円） 濃厚なマンゴーソースがたまらない贅沢パフェ！ひんやり美味しいアイスが、火照った体をスーッと冷やしてくれます🧊 ☕ コーヒーフロート（650円） 濃厚なソフトクリームがたっぷり乗っていてボリューム満点！「このお値段って安い！」と思うくらいコスパ抜群です◎ 店内は涼しくて快適。さらに子連れでも入りやすいのが本当に助かるポイント👶🍼 スイーツもとっても美味しいので、迎賓館観光の際はぜひ立ち寄ってみてくださいね！

きれいで広いカフェです。 赤坂離宮近くですご、周りには他に集客イベントもないため、客層が落ち着いています。 店はドーナツ型の建物で、中央の噴水をぐるっと囲んで席がレイアウトされています。 大きな窓が明るく気持ちいいです。 カレーやパスタ、パンなどのプレートランチやデザート単品などもあり、商品の幅もそこそこ広いです。 また、アイスクリームが乗ったフロートを頼んでいる人が多くいましたが、アイスの巻きが見たこともないくらい綺麗でした。 コーヒー自体はまぁ普通でした。 店内が広くて綺麗！ それだけで良かったです。

店内は広くて、明るくて清潔感があります。 セルフサービスのお店ですが、その分料金は手ごろだと思います。（東京のど真ん中という意味で） 晩餐会のオニオングラタンスープなどあって、わくわくします。 食事（セットプレートにしました）は女性なら満足出来る量だと思います。 男性だと少し物足りないかもしれません？ ケーキも大変美味しかったです。 お土産コーナーには令和／平成クリアファイルといった面白いグッズから、お菓子やお茶など販売されているようでした。 そちらを覗いてみても面白いかと思います。 無料の休憩所と繋がっています。 お手洗いも休憩所にありますが大変綺麗で手入れが行き届いておりました。

2534.a: Togakushi-Jinja Chusha, Chūsha-3506 Togakushi, Nagano, 381-4101, Japan
2534.aj: 〒381-4101 長野県長野市戸隠中社３５０６ 戸隠神社 中社
2534.ed: Shinto site consisting of 5 shrines, with paths lined by soaring Japanese cedar trees.
2534.edj: 5 社からなる神社。境内には高くそびえる杉の並木がある。

rv.t: Nice shrine, made even more special with the 700 year old ancient tree. So many amulets for sale but no English translation; and frowned upon when using phone and GoogleTranslate. No picture policy. I also saw a local getting a stamp in her souvenir book. She paid ¥1,000. I always thought those stamps were free.

2.Mar.2026: snow has melted and the path is slippery. **Right Togakushi Chusha middle temple, You can see very large cedar trees here. If you are looking for Togakushi Okusha, top high temple, with the famous path lined by two rows of cedar trees, you must walk about 2 km further from Chusha. Many visitors mistakenly think Chusha is Okusha. You can save nearly half the walking time by taking the bus from Kagami Pond…
Drive through the middle shrine. If walking from the lower shrine estimated time will be 1.30 -2 hours

2535.a: Uokin Gotanda, 松楽ビル B1F 2 Chome-2-2 Higashigotanda, Shinagawa City, Tokyo 141-0022, Japan
2535.aj: 〒141-0022 東京都品川区東五反田２丁目２−２ 松楽ビル B1F 都民酒場魚金
catj: シーフード・海鮮料理店
2535.edj: 新鮮かつ安全、安心にこだわった海の幸を提供している。自家製コロッケなど各種一品料理も数多く取り揃えている。

rv.t: Tasty small dishes, from sashimi to grilled foods. Good for solo or group dining. Like a other reviewer said, no English menu, but use Google or AI (Perplexity, gpt) to translate the menu.

Food is decent but portion is kinda small. More suitable for drinks than for dinner. Beware when they asked you to sit on the second floor, it’s a super tiny attic that you basically have to crawl into lol
Resoanble price good food. Worth to visit if you are in this area. Seems like the sasimi plate is popular. *we asked for english menu!

2535.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 15:00

2536.a: Sushi Isshin, 2 Chome-5-6 Akasaka, Minato City, Tokyo 107-0052, Japan
2536.aj: 〒107-0052 東京都港区赤坂２丁目５−６ 鮨一新
2536.ed: Diners like this sushi restaurant's high-quality sushi, especially the fresh tuna, sea urchin, and salmon roe, and appreciate the generous portion sizes. They also highlight the exceptional value, noting that the prices are significantly lower than comparable establishments. Guests mention the lively atmosphere, attentive staff, and comfortable dining experience, even for those with children.
2536.edj: 寿司職人の厳しい目で選んだネタがいただける。メニューはおまかせコースがメイン。カウンター席の他、テーブル席もある。

rv.t: Dont know what is the membership only, but this is not a public restaurant. This shouldn't be visible on google. That's unfortunate because the pictures was quite appealing.

The people giving it 1 star are ridiculous. Stop being entitled. Their site clearly says it is members only. There is no discrimination. Restaurants can be members only. If you are a member or know a member you have to get reservations in advance. Amazing sushi either way.

They wouldn’t allow me in, she first said members only and then she said reservation required. I’m only upset because I wasted my time coming here when I gotta go to airport after and this my last chance to have sushi

2536.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 17:00

2537.a: Japan, 〒401-0502 Yamanashi, Minamitsuru District, Yamanakako, Hirano, 1414-1 Yamanaka Terrace
2537.aj: 〒401-0502 山梨県南都留郡山中湖村平野１４１４−１ Yamanaka Terrace
2537.ed: People say this cafe offers delicious coffee, including flat whites and pour-overs, along with tasty desserts like cheesecake and chocolate cake. They also highlight the beautiful, thoughtfully designed interior and exterior, which provide a calm and relaxing atmosphere amidst nature. Visitors appreciate the friendly and welcoming staff, as well as the convenient cashless payment options.
2537.edj: このカフェを利用した人は、フラットホワイトやプアオーバーなどのコーヒー、チーズケーキやチョコレートケーキなどのデザートが美味しいと評価しています。また、自然に囲まれた、美しく考え抜かれた内装と外装も高く評価されており、穏やかでリラックスできる雰囲気を提供しているという声が多くあります。訪れた人は、親しみやすいスタッフと便利なキャッシュレス決済も気に入っているようです。

rv.t: We were hunting for a good coffee. Saw the pictures and were encouraged to drive just over half an hour so the coffee better be good And it was so damn good. They make espresso style as well as pour over coffee. We really needed a good strong coffee. It’s not on their menu but we’ve been assured by the owner that if you order a cortado or piccolo the barista would know exactly what you mean and would make it well…

This cafe is absolutely beautiful and well designed. The wooden interior really stands out and gives the whole cafe a warm, natural, and calming vibe. With all the natural light coming through the big windows, it feels very open and peaceful, and the design blends perfectly with the surrounding forest area. The pastry and drinks were great and tasty too! Service was friendly and welcoming. Whether you come for a…

Wonderful experience! If you are looking for a cafe off the path. This is a great place to visit before, during, or even after your stay in Yamanaka. This place offers high quality coffee that will make you want to revisit. The baked goods like the chocolate chip cookies are a great pairing with your coffee. The view is wonderful and ambience is cozy and hearty!

2538.a: Hamonishokudo Korean Restaurant, 2階 3 Chome-11-14 Akasaka, Minato City, Tokyo 107-0052, Japan
2538.aj: 〒107-0052 東京都港区赤坂３丁目１１−１４ 2階 韓国料理 ハモニ食堂
2538.ed: People say this Korean restaurant offers delicious and authentic dishes, including cold noodles with icy broth, hearty sundubu, and flavorful samgyetang. They also highlight the generous portions, reasonable prices, and the complimentary, unlimited kimchi. Guests mention the clean and calm atmosphere, the quick service, and the convenience of being open 24 hours.
2538.edj: この韓国料理店を利用した人は、冷たいスープの冷麺、温まるスンドゥブ、風味豊かなサムゲタンなど、本格的で美味しい料理を提供していると評価しています。また、ボリュームのある料理、手頃な価格、無料でおかわり自由のキムチも高く評価されています。店内は清潔で落ち着いた雰囲気で、料理の提供も早く、24時間営業しているため便利というクチコミが多くあります。

rv.t: I ate brunch here twice with my husband. Food was amazing and we both loved everything we ordered but on our 2nd time in the restaurant, one of the female staff was rude. We were still eating then she came to our table and got the kimchi bowls without even saying a word. During our 1st time there, they didn’t do that so I was so surprised she did that the 2nd time. It was our 2nd bowl of the lettuce kimchi and we…

We went without reservation. Korean food which opens 24 hours It’s really good one :) taste like korean food in Korea. But when you sit around 1 hour they will take the dish that you have finished and pass you receipt to pay😂 Food is good tho and a bit expensive

Good Korean food! We went without a reservation and were seated, but I'd recommend making one on Tablelog to be safe. It tasted very authentic. Service was quick and friendly, even though everything is mostly in Japanese. Be prepared to translate or ask for recommendations! It's a bit expensive and they brought the bill pretty quickly after we finished, but worth it for the flavor. Accepts cash and card.

2539.a: Parkside Diner, 本館 1階 1 Chome-1-1 Uchisaiwaicho, Chiyoda City, Tokyo 100-8558, Japan
2539.aj: 〒100-8558 東京都千代田区内幸町１丁目１−１ 本館 1階 パークサイドダイナー
catj: ブランチ レストラン
コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
2539.ed: All-day, western-style menus of pancakes, pasta & steak in an old-timey hotel restaurant.
2539.edj: パンケーキ、パスタ、ステーキなどの洋食メニューが終日楽しめる、クラシカルな雰囲気のホテル内レストラン。

rv.t: We stayed for 5 nights at Imperial Hotel Tokyo and chose this as our daily breakfast option. They were able to cater for one of our party who is allergic to tree nuts and sunflower seeds. We could select the set breakfast option or items from the menu totalling the the cost of the set meal. The food/drink was excellent and came in decent sized portions. We also wish to commend Mimura - she was so friendly and…

The chocolate milkshake is GOOD! Wagyu burger is okay, potato wedges were GOOD. Escargot was GOOD. Curry is okay. The only downside was they forgot to serve the salad that came with the food. And wishes they could serve the cold water right after you are seated instead of us asking for it.

Very nice diner inside the Imperial Hotel Tokyo. The service is great and the atmosphere is what a diner should have. The food is also very good. But of course, this is nothing like a traditional Japanese, and may not be what I was expecting when coming to Tokyo.

2540.a: Hibiya Matsumotoro, 1-2 Hibiyakoen, Chiyoda City, Tokyo 100-0012, Japan
2540.aj: 〒100-0012 東京都千代田区日比谷公園１−２ 日比谷松本楼
catj: 日本式洋食レストラン
2540.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious classic Western dishes, especially the rich Hayashi rice, flavorful curries, and creamy crab croquettes. They also highlight the beautiful, relaxed atmosphere, particularly the comfortable terrace seating amidst the park's greenery. Guests mention the staff are attentive and provide excellent service, making for a pleasant dining experience.
2540.edj: 日比谷公園内にある緑に囲まれた老舗洋食店。明治36年に創業。カレーライス、ハヤシライス、オムレツライスなどが味わえる。テラス席有。

rv.t: We came on a rainy day. It was very quiet. In a sunny day the view would have been better to look over the Hibiya park. Service is excellent. Western food and delicately presented. We had lunch set with open burger, it is tasty, tender yet with colorful vege decorated. I enjoyed the time here.

A heritage gem of curry expertise. We thoroughly enjoyed our late lunch here. The staff are so good and helpful and friendly that you immerse yourself in luxary of peace and comfort with a delectable wine food pairing for a peaceful meal inside the beautiful Hibiya garden. A must go while in Tokyo. Thank you very much Matsumotoro.

Excellent Omu rice right in the heart of the Venice Hibiya Park and next to the Gingko tree. Absolutely beautiful sight to behold while enjoying the food. Omu rice comes with a choice of 2 out of the five choices .

2540.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

2541.a: Himokawa-kiryu Ikebukuro, 3 Chome-18-35 Minamiikebukuro, Toshima City, Tokyo 171-0022, Japan
2541.aj: 〒171-0022 東京都豊島区南池袋３丁目１８−３５ ひもかわ桐生 池袋店
2541.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious udon, especially the unique, wide Himokawa udon, and the crispy tempura, including chicken and soft-boiled egg. They also highlight the friendly and efficient staff, as well as the bright and welcoming atmosphere. Guests mention the reasonable prices for the quality and the convenient payment options, including credit cards and QR codes.
2541.edj: このうどん店を利用した人は、おいしいうどん、特に珍しい幅広のひもかわうどんと、鶏肉や半熟卵などのサクサクした天ぷらを高く評価しています。また、スタッフは親切で手際が良く、店内は明るく居心地が良いという声が多くあります。質の割に値段が手頃で、クレジットカードやQRコードなど支払い方法が便利な点も好評です。

rv.t: One of the best udon meals I’ve had in Japan. I ordered the Jō Tenzaru with the Aimori option, which lets you enjoy both regular udon and Himokawa udon (the extra-wide noodles). If it’s your first time here, I highly recommend choosing this option. The Himokawa noodles were the biggest surprise. They were incredibly smooth, soft, and pleasantly chewy, much better than I expected. The regular udon were also…

We went soon after the restaurant opened and there were 2 groups in front of us. We ordered from a piece of paper, it had an English side so ordering was very easy. I ordered mixed noodles and wished I ordered only the flat udon. The flat udon noodle was a little difficult to eat but the noodles were so smooth I've never had anything like it before, recommend trying the flat udon noodles here! Food was made to order…

I’m not really an udon person but I think this place was worth standing in a 20-30min line on a Sunday. The staff were also very nice. I wish they had drinks that weren’t just soda or alcohol but there was free water. It would also be better if they gave proper chopsticks instead of the disposable ones because the noodles are really heavy and it was a chore to lift them.

2541.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

2542.a: Japan, 〒410-2113 Shizuoka, Izunokuni, Naka, 272-1 蔵屋鳴沢 反射炉ビヤ醸造所
2542.aj: 〒410-2113 静岡県伊豆の国市中２７２−１ 蔵屋鳴沢 反射炉ビヤ醸造所

rv.t: I visited here on my walking beer trek across Shizuoka and the beer here was world class, literally. The brew master, Yamada-san, just won an award for the World’s best American Pale Ale category on August 14th. A TV crew just happened to be there while I was there. Bottled beer is available in the shop next door. If you are in the area, you definitely have to try their selection of beers. Masterful! Cheers 🍻
Be aware the restaurant was closed on 15 Jan 2024… their website must be updated
今年新作のクラフトビールです🍺 緑茶の爽やかな風味と喉越しが良くとても美味しかったです。茶摘体験の後だったので季節感も感じられてより一層美味しかったです😋

2543.a: Fukui Prefectural Dinosaur Museum, 51-11 Murokocho Terao, Katsuyama, Fukui 911-8601, Japan
2543.aj: 〒911-8601 福井県勝山市村岡町寺尾５１−１１ 福井県立恐竜博物館
2543.ed: Modern paleontology museum featuring reconstructed dinosaur bones, fossils & outdoor excavations.
2543.edj: 近代的な古生物学の博物館。復元された恐竜の骨、化石、野外発掘場を見学できる。

rv.t: Okay, I’ll admit I didn’t believe the hype when I first read the reviews for this place. How cool could a dinosaur museum be? Well, I was glad to be proven wrong. It’s a wonderful museum, from the architectural design to the jaw-dropping descent of the escalator deep into the “egg” to the layout of the museum. It’s worth visiting more than once! I easily spent 3 hours there, and would spend more time to explore the…

This dinosaur museum is truly outstanding and highly impressive. The exhibits are thoughtfully curated and presented in a way that is both engaging and informative, making the entire experience enjoyable from start to finish. What makes this museum especially remarkable is how it brings the world of dinosaurs to life in such an interesting and accessible way. The displays are visually captivating and well-explained…

Fukui Prefectural Dinosaur Museum is an amazing place—one of the best dinosaur museums in Japan! The exhibits are huge and impressive, with life-sized skeletons and realistic moving dinosaurs. The building itself is spacious and modern, making it easy to explore. Great for kids and adults alike, with interactive areas and even fossil experiences. It can get busy, so coming early is recommended. Definitely worth the…

2544.a: Towel Museum, Ko-2930 Asakurakami, Imabari, Ehime 799-1607, Japan
2544.aj: 〒799-1607 愛媛県今治市朝倉上甲２９３０ タオル美術館
2544.ed: People say this museum offers a wide variety of towels, including character goods and unique art made from towels, with many finding the manufacturing process interesting. Visitors also highlight the beautiful European-style garden, ample parking, and the helpful staff. Other reviews mention the towels can be foreign-made.
2544.edj: この美術館を訪れた人は、キャラクターグッズやタオルで作られたユニークなアート作品など、多種多様なタオルが揃っていると評価しています。製造工程に興味を持つ人も多く、美しいヨーロッパ風の庭園、十分な駐車スペース、そして親切なスタッフも高く評価されています。 一方で、タオルの中には外国製のものもあるというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: A large 19th century european style building with around 4-6 floors? each floor had a shop or 2 selling towels or souvenirs and then the top floor consists of more towel shops, a cafe/restaurant , the towel museum entrance and the entrance to the outside garden. Prices of towels in each shop are similar/same with some minor differences for certain sizes. But prices here are about the same or more expensive than…

Visited for the time limited exhibitions on Snoopy and Moomin, and was pretty entertained by the experience. They really used towels to build every exhibit to showcase the quality and ability of the material. The museum shop has a fine selection of locally made towels. A fun visit!

An art museum centred mainly around towels since this is Imabari, the town famous for towels. Admission is on the 4th floor just take the escalator up. It currently has theme of Snoopy/Peanuts and Moomin. The shops sells all sorts of towels, including themes like mofusand, pokemon, etc

2544.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 9:30

2545.a: Tachibana Shokudo, 287-1 Mukaishimacho Tachibana, Onomichi, Hiroshima 722-0071, Japan
2545.aj: 〒722-0071 広島県尾道市向島町立花２８７−１ forumiest table（旧立花食堂）
2545.edj: 定食ものから麺類、デザートも提供するナチュラルモダンな一軒家カフェ。テラス席を備え、キッチン雑貨の販売も行う。

rv.t: This is one the best experiences I’ve had. The food and service is amazing! The deserts are to die for🤤 Michelin star🔥
Loved this little craft/ice cream/restaurant stop along the way from the Shimanami Kaido cycle route not far from Onimichi. If you like handmade clothing of high quality go upstairs in the gift shop.

I always love to stop by Tachibana Shokudo whenever cycling Shimanami Kaido. The service and the food are great. They were flexible about substituting the other stuff for my friend who has a allergic to gluten. The view of the epic cycling coast road behind their greenery garden is always the best🌴😍✨

2545.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00（土）

2546.a: E-chan Shokudo, サンライズ目黒 3 Chome-4-6 Shimomeguro, Meguro City, Tokyo 153-0064, Japan
2546.aj: 〒153-0064 東京都目黒区下目黒３丁目４−６ サンライズ目黒 えーちゃん食堂
2546.ed: People say this ramen shop offers delicious, deeply flavorful ramen with a rich, complex broth and springy noodles. They also highlight the generous portions of juicy chashu and the management's kind demeanor. Some reviews mention the ramen can be salty.
2546.edj: このラーメン店を訪れたユーザーは、風味豊かな醤油ベースのスープと、弾力のあるよく調理された麺を高く評価しています。スープは魚介や鶏の出汁が効いていることが多いようです。また、柔らかいチャーシューのボリュームの多さや、店主の効率的で親しみやすいサービスも好評です。 一部のクチコミでは、スタッフの対応が丁寧ではないという意見もあります。

rv.t: I FINALLY made it this morning! YAY! The wait at 650am on a Monday was not too bad, about 30 minutes but there are little stools for you to sit on as you get closer to the shop. The turnover is very quick. I can't speak or understand much Japanese but the master seems very happy and kind. He is a one-man operation and seems to really enjoy himself ☺️ Mondays are limited edition days and today's special was bonjiri…

I had a fantastic shoyu chashu ramen for breakfast. I arrived at the shop around 6 AM and was greeted with a 45-minute wait. With only 6 seats and a one-man operation, the owner runs the entire show himself. The shoyu broth is slightly salty yet deeply flavourful and complex, striking a perfect balance that keeps you coming back for more. The noodles are excellent — springy, well-cooked, and they pair beautifully…

Limited hours. Wait time could be an hour. It's only one guy running it hence some side dishes could run out very fast. Ramen bowl is delicious (although it's not my type of Ramen). Location:*** Ambience:*** Price:**** Food:****

2547.a: Japan, 〒141-0021 Tokyo, Shinagawa City, Kamiosaki, 2 Chome−15−5 長者丸ビル １Ｆ スパゲティダン
2547.aj: 〒141-0021 東京都品川区上大崎２丁目１５−５ 長者丸ビル １Ｆ スパゲティダン
2547.ed: Diners like this restaurant's wide variety of delicious tarako spaghetti, featuring chewy noodles and rich sauces with toppings like uni, squid, and natto. They also appreciate the nostalgic, retro cafe atmosphere and the attentive staff. Other reviews mention the toppings can be sparse.
2547.edj: このレストランを利用した人は、もちもちした麺と濃厚なソースが特徴の、たらこスパゲッティの種類の豊富さを高く評価しています。ウニ、イカ、納豆などのトッピングも好評です。また、昔ながらのレトロな喫茶店のような雰囲気や、スタッフの丁寧な対応も気に入っているようです。 一方で、トッピングの具材が少ないというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: Tastes pretty good (bland Japanese style pasta) but the portions are way too small and overpriced. Not my kind of pasta, but we all have preferences. I ordered a large size (oomori) but still had to get a sandwich on my way home because I wasn’t satisfied.
My favorite is pasta with uni, mentaiko, and squid. Portion is a bit small but delicious.
I really like spaghetti here! Japanese style spaghetti with tarako base and with many variations. Prices are fair.

2547.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:30

2548.a: MUTO coffee roastery, 3 Chome-34-18 Nakano, Nakano City, Tokyo 164-0001, Japan
2548.aj: MUTO coffee roastery, ３丁目-３４-１８ 中野 中野区 東京都 164-0001
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
2548.ed: People say this cafe offers delicious, freshly roasted coffee with a balanced flavor, and many enjoy the moist cheesecake and gateau chocolat. They also highlight the calm and relaxing atmosphere, making it a great spot for reading or working. Others appreciate the convenient electronic payment options and the attentive staff.
2548.edj: 世界各地の産地や農園から厳選された豆を、ハンドドリップで淹れるコーヒーが味わえる。自家製ケーキも用意されている。

rv.t: I’d give it a 4.5 if I could. It’s a nice little coffee shop, with a mix of old school and modern. The coffee was nice and strong, and I ordered the cheesecake to go with it. The cheesecake was very traditional, and not super sweet, but paired well with the coffee. The inside is cozy, and the owners were nice and friendly. You can buy an assortment of beans as well. Good spot to take a break and relax.

Had a decent cup of coffee here. Great atmosphere and very relaxing but focuses more on medium roast city blends and French roast blends. I'm a light roast guy, so while not my preference, it's still a good cup of coffee. The chocolate cake was also good and light.

The coffee here was fantastic rich flavor and clearly high quality. Unfortunately, I can only give three stars because my cup was filled barely three quarters of the way, even though there was still more left in the carafe. The two people next to me received full cups, so it felt a bit inconsistent. For ¥700, I expected a full pour. Great coffee, but disappointing attention to detail.

2548.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:30

2549.a: Kōenji Temple, 4 Chome-18-11 Koenjiminami, Suginami City, Tokyo 166-0003, Japan
2549.aj: 〒166-0003 東京都杉並区高円寺南４丁目１８−１１ 高円寺

rv.t: A truly beautiful and incredibly peaceful spot, Kōenji Temple is one of those places that instantly slows you down. Tucked away from the noise, it offers a deep sense of calm, where every step feels meditative. What struck me most was the intoxicating scent of flowers that filled the air during my visit, it made the whole experience feel almost dreamlike. The temple grounds are simple but full of charm, perfect for…

Very quiet serene temple. It seems you can enter. At first I thought I couldn't enter but after reading other reviews I searched around and found a side entrance that was open and peeked in and saw another Japanese visitor so I went inside. When I was coming back there were 5 other visitors so I think it's okay to come inside the premises.
We were too late to go in as it closes at 5pm. We managed to take some photos in the courtyard during dusk. It was very pretty.

2550.a: Underground Exploration Museum RYU-Q Kan, 720 Kamikanasaki, Kasukabe, Saitama 344-0111, Japan
2550.aj: 〒344-0111 埼玉県春日部市上金崎７２０ 地底探検ミュージアム 龍Q館(庄和排水機場)
2550.ed: Tours of a municipal subterranean drainage channel with 18-meter-tall pillars & soaring ceilings.
2550.edj: 地下にある高さ 18 m の柱と調圧水槽天井を見学できる首都圏外郭放水路のミュージアム。

rv.t: I joined the underground tour just for fun, expecting a little adventure, but I ended up learning a lot! While waiting, I looked at the exhibits and listened to the staff’s explanations, which helped me understand how the facility works to prevent flooding. For the underground tour, we borrowed waterproof suits and walked through the water. It was a unique and exciting experience, and I had a great time!

Amazing underground experience for just 1000 yen. If you’re into industrial buildings and architecture, this is your place. Make sure to book your tickets on the website. You can book first then pay in person on your tour day. Japanese knowledge or live translation is nice to have but not mandatory. No cell reception once you get downstairs. The level of humidity inside will vary depending on the season of the year.

It’s a surreal experience, especially when you understand the history behind it or why it was built and how it benefits all the areas that used to suffer from flooding. The engineering and effort that went into creating this megastructure are truly remarkable. To visit, you’ll need a car, or you can walk about 20–30 minutes from the nearest station.

2550.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 9:30

2551.a: Mawashi Sushi Katsu Meguro, アトレ目黒2 1階 3 Chome-1-1 Kamiosaki, Shinagawa City, Tokyo 141-0021, Japan
2551.aj: 〒141-0021 東京都品川区上大崎３丁目１−１ アトレ目黒2 1階 回し寿司活 目黒店
2551.ed: Diners praise this sushi restaurant for its fresh, high-quality, and generously portioned sushi, which includes a wide variety of seasonal and unique options. They also highlight the excellent value and convenient queueing system. Some reviews mention the service can be slow.
2551.edj: 季節限定メニューのほか、常時新メニューも提案している。テイクアウトでも注文でき、宴会に最適な出張回転寿司サービスも提供している。

rv.t: An absolute hidden gem for sushi lovers! If you are looking for top-tier quality without breaking the bank, this place is unmatched. - How to Find It: It is located on the 1st floor of Atre Meguro 2, just a 1-minute walk from the JR Meguro Station East Exit. It’s tucked away right behind the Seijo Ishii supermarket, so keep an eye out for the traditional Japanese lanterns and storefront display. - The Ticketing &…

I wanted Sushi for lunch, but didn't break my pocket. I found this sushi train style restaurant on Tabelog with a fairly high rating, but reasonable prices. The shop fromt is not visible from the front gates. Going through a small corridor beside Seijo Ishii Supermarket. The ordering is all done with a tablet. I ordered 7 plates, tuna, squid, snapper, sardines, bonito, some rolled sushis and a bowl of fish soup…

Mawashi Sushi is a hidden gem found in atre 2 . The queue was long (1.5hour) but is it worth the wait ? Absolutely. Every piece of sushi is done with detailed precise seasoning and the sushi servings are generous. Is like you just entered another realm of sushi and tasting the flavors of the sea. Once you pop that one piece in your mouth , your waiting frustrations just evaporated. Yummy and delicious

2551.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

2552.a: Taipei Gyoza, メトロ 新 高円寺 マンション 1F 1 Chome-13-11 Umezato, Suginami City, Tokyo 166-0011, Japan
2552.aj: 〒166-0011 東京都杉並区梅里１丁目１３−１１ メトロ 新 高円寺 マンション 1F 台北餃子

rv.t: 今まで食べた中華でいちばん好みかも！！ やはり本格的中華！よりも台湾料理寄りだからなのでしょうか？ どれを食べても美味しく、次はまた違うメニューを試してみたいけど、今日いただいたメニューがどれも大正解すぎてまた同じものを頼んでしまいそう。笑 餃子はシソ餃子をいただきましたが 恐らくオーダーを入れてから包んでくださってるのでは？と思うくらいシソの香りが高く、羽もバッチリでとても美味しかった！ しかも2人だと通常5個入りが半端になっちゃうだろうからと、6個にも変更できますよ？とお気遣いくださって6個にしてもらいました。 レバニラは、レバーがいい具合の火の入りで最高！ お会計は現金のみですので、注意が必要ですね。 今度はランチでもお邪魔してみたい！
特別じゃない“普通”の良さが◎。日常使いしたい良い食事処。 ランチで辛担々麺(黒)と五目チャーハン，餃子を注文。辛担々麺(黒)は見た目すごく辛そうでやや警戒したがそんなに辛くなく食べやすい。他もホッとする家庭的な味で、こうして口コミ書きながら思い出しまた食べたくなってきた。 女性従業員の方の「美味しかったですか？」の一言が温かく感じる。
ランチのお勧めメニューをいただきました。 唐揚げと玉子の炒め物みたいな？ 写真の内容に杏仁豆腐がつきます♪ 唐揚げは多分、冷凍食品使ってました。 衣の感じといい、味といい良く弁当で食べた味w これは残念。 ご飯おかわり出来るのは良かったです。 次回はラーメンと炒飯か餃子を食べてみたいです。

2552.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

2553.a: Toneri Park, 1 Chome-1 Tonerikoen, Adachi City, Tokyo 121-0837, Japan
2553.aj: 〒121-0837 東京都足立区舎人公園１丁目１ 舎人公園
2553.ed: Suburban park with a baseball field, tennis courts & barbecue facilities, plus paths around a lake.
2553.edj: 野球場、テニスコート、バーベキュー施設のある郊外の公園。湖の周囲に歩道もある。

rv.t: Visited during the illumination festival and it was an amazing experience. The entire park transformed into a colourful light show with beautiful displays spread throughout the grounds. The glowing flower installations, illuminated trees and reflections across the water created such a relaxing and magical atmosphere. It was perfect for families, couples and anyone wanting a peaceful evening walk while enjoying the…

Toneri Park is absolutely breathtaking right now! I visited during the evening, and the Nymphilia (Baby Blue Eyes) are in full bloom, creating a stunning "blue carpet" effect that rivals some of the more famous spots outside of Tokyo.

We visit Toneri Park regularly for evening walks, and it’s always such a pleasant experience. It’s a very big park with plenty of space to explore. We recently went during an event day, and it was exceptionally pretty with all the special decorations and atmosphere. It’s a great local spot whether you're looking for a quiet stroll or a lively event! Car Parking available.

Kyushu Hakata Tonkotsu Ramen restaurant in Koenji. I visited the restaurant after confirming in advance via X that it was open for business. a bowl for flat rate 1000y and able to add noodle balls as much you want till you full enough. one of the stinky pork smelling reminds my childhood memories by authentic kyushu cooking method.

rv.t: A heaven for people just looking to read their book in a nice atmosphere with silence. The individual tables accommodates single readers and the whole vibe of the place is calm and cosy. The coffee and snacks also facilitates reading. Will go back here some other day to enjoy a longer time.

It was an absolutely amazing experience to find this small authentic cafe. I wish I had a chance to see it in the daylight but in the evening it's also worth seeing. The atmosphere is very calm and interesting if you want to escape from the city rush and have a nice cup of drink in silence I definitely recommend this place. You can study or read books there as well. It looks like these study and coffee places but…

Great cafe. They have a strict “no talking” policy that customers respect. The place has a quiet, comfortable, peaceful atmosphere, with sounds of nature playing in the background (like crickets). It has a vintage vibe, with old furniture and little, cute decorations all around. They have a bunch of books you can read; most of them (if not all) are in Japanese. They have fish tanks as well. Seats are separated in…

Nice neighbourhood if u got extra nothing to do in Tokyo or a frequent Tokyo traveller

2558.edj: このレストランを利用した人は、カニクリームコロッケやトリュフオムレツなど、多国籍で幅広い種類の美味しい料理がボリュームたっぷりで提供されると評価しています。また、飲み放題付きのコースはコストパフォーマンスが非常に高いという声が多くあります。店内は懐かしく、かわいらしく、居心地の良い雰囲気で、スタッフも親切で丁寧な対応だと好評です。

rv.t: This place is a hidden gem tucked away in the heart of Akihabara. The atmosphere is cozy and intimate, making it a perfect spot for a relaxed evening. The fusion of Italian and Japanese cuisine is executed with finesse, offering a unique dining experience. I tried their signature stone-oven pizza, which was a delightful blend of flavors and textures. The freshly harvested vegetable bagna càuda was another standout…
Very tasty food set, get your stomach ready! You will need a lot of space.
Very friendly staff, very tasty food for a reasonable price!

2559.ed: People say this taqueria offers authentic Mexican street tacos, with popular choices like suadero and carnitas being juicy and flavorful. They also highlight the lively, welcoming atmosphere and friendly, multilingual staff. Other reviews mention the tacos can be overpriced.
2559.edj: クチコミによると、このタコス店は本格的なメキシコのストリートタコスを提供しており、特にスアデロやカルニタスといった人気のタコスは、ジューシーで風味豊かだと評判です。また、活気があり居心地の良い雰囲気や、親しみやすく多言語に対応するスタッフも高く評価されています。 一方で、タコスは値段が高いという意見もあります。

rv.t: As a frequent visitor, I can assure you that this is the most authentic and fresh Mexican taco stand you can ever find in Tokyo. Five different types of tacos are offered at this place, and the slow cooked meat, combined with freshly baked corn tortillas and cilantros gives incredible fragrance and flavor!

This place has been my go to for Mexican food! One of the things I miss back when I was living in the US was Mexican food! It’s been a dream of mine to visit Mexico and even Italy because of the food! I come from Philippines, so plane tickets are pretty expensive because those two countries are far away! But because Japan is only 4 to 5 hours by airplane from Philippines, I go to this place for my taco fix! They…

Came all the way from Los Angeles, California and being blessed by outstanding quality of Tacos, I can truly attest to Los 3 Hermanos have 100% quality tacos! Including the meat, salsas, and of course the micheladas! The service was outstanding and for coming in with a party of 12 the orders were spot on correct! Came out fresh and hot straight from the grill. Quality was outstanding and highly recommend this place…

rv.t: Basically the Aussie version of Chipotle, it's not a bad option for that sort of craving. Menu is quite similar; however, this location is in the Atre mall, so it is lacking that larger range of toppings. The taste is pretty similar though. Overall, it's a solid, if not pricey choice for food while at Shinagawa station!

Overpriced slop. Burritos are very expensive and small and half of it's just folded bread. Last time I go to Guzman y Gomez anywhere it's all the same. Water isn't even free here. If desperate for burritos in Tokyo, go to Taco Rico in Roppongi instead for twice the size at the same price and much more delicious.

There are definitely some better Mexican places in Tokyo, but most of them will cost you an arm and a leg for lunch, let alone dinner. Guzman y Gomez isn't cheap either, but there price point is closer to the mark for cost vs. portion, and they don't act like they're more upscale than they really are. I order delivery from this location frequently, and I’m not one to write bad reviews. I also work food service in this area and I know it’s a struggle at times! For the last few orders it takes easily over half an hour for them to even finish prepping the food, which I don’t really have a problem with usually. However…

rv.t: Nice little farmers market! I found beautiful sweet peas currently in season. Also had the most delicious berries from Schuh farms. Giving it 4 stars because there weren’t that many booths overall.

Adorable. Delightful. Has a gluten free bakery stand too (celiac safe, altho there’s a regular bakery too so be careful and make sure you’re at the right stand!). There’s lots of unique stands too, produce, flowers, mushrooms, honey, and tons of other food that smells great (I can’t eat most due to gluten but it evokes envy, so if you have no dietary restrictions please eat in my honor). The only issue is it gets…

It is one fabulous farmer's market. I bought the most delicious jams from a vendor and he was absolutely dedicated to his craft. We snacked it up on soups, homemade breads and salmon burgers. It is one of my favorite thing to do when I am in Seattle for a weekend.

rv.t: Pike Place Market was easily one of the highlights of our family trip to Seattle. We went on a Monday around 8:30am and spent about 3 hours there, but we honestly could have stayed longer. Going early made a big difference. We were able to see the fish throwing twice before the crowds got too heavy, and it was much easier to walk around at first. Later in the morning, the market got busier and walking with our…

Loved the whole market experience. There are so many shops to explore, unique items to try, great gifts. We tried so many things day one and feel like we didn’t even make a dent. It gets very busy on the weekends and though the weekdays were still busy it wasn’t quite as bad. We loved the variety of food, art, goods. Just such a unique environment!

Visited on a Tuesday in July and loved it. The market was packed when we went but still enjoyable. We took photos with the public market signs and got to see the fish throw. Also put some gum on the gum wall and saw the original Starbucks. Definitely worth your time and a must-visit on your trip to Seattle.

This review is about a winter concert/rave, so others can be prepared in the future- The venue inside was chilly the whole time; wish I'd brought a warmer coat. There was coat check if needed. If you don't like long bathroom lines, they had lots of porta potties located outside. Lots of space for flow toys. Bar was simple, but covered the bases. Recommend rideshare, though there is free parking available.

We were here for Seattle Night market and this place is huge. Easily accomodates 10 food trucks and plenty of stalls indoors. It can accomodate huge crowd too and still not feel suffocating. All in all this is a nice event space! Ample parking around as well which is a huge advantage!

2567.ed: Inspired by Jimi Hendrix, the museum includes items from icons ranging from Bo Diddley to Bob Dylan.

rv.t: This was an unplanned visit when visting the Space Needle, and so glad I dropped in. They have created a really immersive event in a huge space. Set out into specific themes and done to a really high standard. There is so much to see hear and touch with super interesting facts and exhibits. My personal favourite was the Science Fiction zone, they have done this to an incredible standard and filled it with great…

The Museum of Pop Culture is definitely one of the most interesting and unique museums to visit in Seattle. Even the building itself is worth seeing because the architecture is so unusual and colorful, and once you go inside there is much more to explore than I expected. What I enjoyed most is the variety. It is not just a museum about music. There are exhibitions connected to rock, grunge, famous musicians, movies…

We went here today after our cruise as it started raining and we needed a dry place to hang out. I was pleasantly surprised at the thought and detail that went into the exhibits and collections and story told throughout. My family and I had a great time and we learned that pop culture isn't just music, it's video games, movies, people and events. Who knew! Go, have fun, read your way through the history, you won't…

rv.t: This place was beautiful. Made me feel like I was back in Japan. Took my mother who loves gardens and she was so pleased. They have clean bathroom at the entrance and several benches in the garden you can sit and talk or just enjoy the view. The upkeep was pristine and immaculate. Very quiet and peaceful. Not sure if there is a time limit to how long you can stay but I could stay all day. Free parking next to garden…

We visited the garden on a lightly rainy day, and admission was $10 per person. The staff greeted us with warm smiles and were kind enough to lend umbrellas to visitors who needed them. There is also a gift shop located right by the ticket counter, conveniently positioned near the entrance and exit. Free guided tours are available as well, and the guides are both friendly and professional. The story behind the…

This is a beautiful well-designed and magical place. We were fortunate enough to go on a sunny day at the height of spring. The way this type of garden works with the natural landscape and the mix of natural elements make it indescribably gorgeous and serene. A tree bursting with large pink blossoms , with a pile of fallen flowers -still pink at its base - are extraordinary eye candy. Balm for the soul.

rv.t: We entered Mount Rainier National Park through the Nisqually entrance and made our way to Paradise. First things first: if you see the “restrooms” about 3 miles in on the right… just keep driving. 😂 They should never be open in July. After surviving that slightly traumatic experience, the rest of the day was pure magic. The park is absolutely breathtaking! We hiked to three gorgeous waterfalls on the “easy” trails…

Absolutely beautiful place! Great views of the mountain, untouched meadows, huge old-growth trees, and majestic waterfalls on bright blue rivers! I cannot say much concerning spending the night inside the park as I stayed just outside the park, but I would still highly recommend this place! Also note that traffic will probably be heavy at places like Paradise and Longmire, and you will have to pay a fee to drive…

This is one of the most picturesque parks we have visited. The wild flowers in July are beautiful and the views of the glacier are amazing. Perfect temperature for hiking. Most important, it's not overcrowded like Yosemite and Yellowstone. Well maintained trail system and facilities.

rv.t: JR Mito Station is clean, well-organized, and very easy to navigate. The signs are clear, and there are plenty of shops, restaurants, and convenience stores inside and around the station. The overall atmosphere is calm, and the staff are polite and helpful, making every trip comfortable and stress-free. Highly recommended for both…

While it is convenient in that you can reach Tokyo directly on a single train, to be honest, there is not much of note around the area. They my travel less complicated and allows me to relax and enjoy. 🇯🇵🇨🇦

I visited this fishing pier on a sunny Sunday. The pier was not very crowded, and I could park the car without an issue. The pier is narrow, and while the tables and chairs are allowed, umbrellas and parasols are not allowed. A small shop rented the fishing rods and sold bait and some snacks. The only food that seemed to fill the stomach was cup noodles.

One of three Fishing piers in Yokohama. Better to catch 85 bus from JR station. 500 yen for male fisher, 300 for female. Good fishes up to 35 cm. There is a small fisher shop. English is not preferable :(

Snacks and drinks are expensive- standard movie theater experience lol- my friends and I got a medium bag of popcorn, a medium slush, and a large soda and it was $37…

Great seats. I did not have to use the restroom during the film, but if so it would have been hard to navigate my way around or up stairs, because there were no visual ques.

We visited around midday on a Tuesday, and the park was very quiet, which made it easy and comfortable to walk around with our 3-year-old. We spent about 15 to 30 minutes in the main park area, mostly walking up the big hill, taking pictures, and enjoying the view. Fun park to visit. I visited pipes a few times, like the fireworks (where I streamed most of the 4th show) and yesterday there was a paddle board get together at Lake Union. Pretty cool! rv.t: Visiting the Space Needle was the perfect highlight of my time in downtown Seattle before heading out on my Alaskan cruise. The 360-degree views from the 520-foot observation deck are simply breathtaking and give an unmatched perspective of the Pacific Northwest. I absolutely loved stepping out onto The Loupe, the world’s first revolving glass floor—it was thrilling to see the city rotating right beneath my feet…

"Iconic Seattle views you can’t miss! 5/5 stars" The Space Needle is absolutely worth it. The 360° views from 520 ft up of downtown, Puget Sound, Mount Rainier, and the Olympic Mountains are breathtaking. The Loupe revolving glass floor is a thrill and the Skyriser glass benches make for amazing photos. Staff were friendly and the timed entry system keeps things moving smoothly. Best time to go is around sunset so…

4.75⭐️. It was really cool. We went during the day around 11:30am. There weren’t too many people it was a little crowded but it could’ve been a lot worse. They have a lot of cool stuff and magnets at the gift shop. The view is really nice and high and they have stairs and an elevator. You can see the elevator and stairs from the outside too.

The staff at the return desk were incredibly helpful. One associate took the time to patiently figure out why my baby registry wasn’t working. She was supportive, positive, and truly went above and beyond—I really appreciate her help.

Target online order and pickup in 2 hrs is awesome. Sometimes it less than 2 hours. Also picking up while your still in parking space is great thing when you don't want to get out of the car or you are in a hurry.
